tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor mos gus srog 'khor gyi dbang khrid zhal gdams kyis brgyan pa bzhugs so/

na mo rat+na gu ru/ rnam dag chos sku 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs sprul sku lhun grub ngo bo nyid// sku bzhi dbyer med drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// mgon po 'bri gung pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'dir 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhal mnga' nas/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhal nas/ chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ thams cad bsdu na sde snod gsum mam rgyud sde bzhir 'dus/ de yang bsdu na rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud du 'dus/ de'i don thams cad bla ma'i mos gus 'ba' zhig las skye ba yin te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang*// mtshams med lnga po byas pas kyang*// chos 'di nyid la zhugs gyur cing*// bla ma la gus yod gyur na// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// bla ma la gus med gyur na// bsgrubs kyang 'grub par yong mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ kyai rdo rje las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bstan pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang bla ma'i mos gus gcig pu la brten nas 'tshang rgya dgos par gsungs te/ bla ma med pa'i gong rol na// sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med// bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas kyang*// bla ma dag la brten nas byung*// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas yang*// bla ma dag la brten nas byung*// zhes gsungs pas/ brgyud pa rin po che 'di'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyang*/ mos gus gsang ba 'dus pa 'di'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ nga rang rjes 'jug rnams kyang 'di'i ngo bor 'tshang rgya dgos pa yin te/ 'di'i lo rgyus dang dgos ched gnyis las/ dang po lo rgyus ni/ sngon rgya gar nub phyogs ri bo dzhu nā shri zhes bya ba'i gnas su/

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po la/ rje btsun til+li pa dang*/ ma ti sā hā dang*/ kar+ṇa ka shrī dang*/ gtum pa'i shugs can dang*/ pañtsa dang*/ nam mkha'i gos can dang*/ dur khrod spyod pa dang*/ brtul zhugs spyod pa dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa brgyad kyis mjal ba'i dus su/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zhus pas/ dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs te/ phyag g.yas pa spyi bor bzhag pas bum dbang gi yon tan rgyud la skyes/ g.yon pa bzhag pas gsang dbang gi yon tan rgyud la skyes/ gnyis ka bzhag pas shes rab ye shes kyi don rgyud la skyes/ sku lus nam mkhar thim pas dbang bzhi pa'i yon tan rgyud la skyes pa dang*/ mos gus gsang ba 'dus pa 'di gsungs pas/ rje btsun til+li pa rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med du gyur nas/ bhaṅga la'i dur khrod du paṇ+ḍi ta gā ya dha ra la gsungs pa/ klu sgrub ār+ya de ba dang*// bcom ldan 'das dang nga gtam byas// sa ra ha ni chen pos kyang*// rtogs pa nga la 'gran du med// mi brjed gzungs thob nā ro pas// bcu gnyis bar du nga mnyes byas// nga yi yon tan kho la yod// phyi rabs rjes 'jug sems can rnams// rtogs par 'dod na kho la 'dud// ces rje rang gi che ba'i yon tan dang*/ zhar la nā ro pa lung bstan pa'o// de ltar dpal ldan nā ro pa chen po lung bstan thob nas/ o tan+ta pu rir til+li pa dang mjal te/ lo bcu gnyis bsten zhing dka' chen bcu gnyis dka' phran brgyad cu spyad pa'i mthar/ sku lus kyi khrag gis chag chag btab/ snyan bcad pa'i tshom bu bkod nas zhus pas/ mos gus gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang khrid gnang nas/ zhal mnga' nas/ mos gus srog gi 'khor lo 'di// sems chos sku ngo sprod kyi bla ma yin// 'du 'bral med par gsol ba thob// sems gzung 'dzin du ma lta nā ro pa// zhes gsungs pas khong rang dang dbyer med du gyur to// de nas rje mar pa rgya gar du byon nas/

nā ro pa dang lo bdun lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te/ gdams pa ma lus pa thugs nyams su bzhes/ phyis kyi dus su gsol ba btab cing mos gus byas pas/ dbang bskur gdams ngag zhal gdams su gnang bas/ lo tsā ba dga' drags nas/ gdams ngag srog gi snying po gnang*// mos gus gnad kyi sgo mo phye// 'khor 'das dbyer med ro gcig pas// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi gdan sa zin// da ni ban chung bod du 'gro// gsungs par gda'/ de nas rje btsun nyid kyis khong gi snyan pa gsan nas drung du byon/ sku mkhar la sogs pa dka' ba dpag tu med pa lo dgu'i bar du spyad/ gsang sngags kyi chos ma lus pa gsan zhing*/ ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas/ mos gus kyi srog 'dzin dang*/ brgyud 'dzin gyi slob mar dgongs te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa 'di gnang nas 'di skad gsungs so// ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa de// mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan yin// gdams ngag byin pa de tsug yin// man ngag sprugs pa'ang de tsug lags// zhes gsungs so// rje btsun nyid kyi sku'i snyan pa rje sgam po pas gsan nas/ drung du byon te gser srang mang du phul ba ma bzhes te/ shangs len ma la sogs pa'i mgur mdzad/ mnyam med rin chen du mtshan gsol/ snod ldan brgyud 'dzin gyi slob mar gzigs nas/ gdams ngag thams cad sba sri med par gnang nas lung bstan te/ gnyal gyi se ba lung du byon nas sgrub pa mdzad pas/ mos gus gyi rtsal rdzogs/ se ba lung ma'i mgur mdzad/ dpal phag mo gru pas rje sgam po pa'i drung du byon nas/ bla ma la mos gus khyad par du 'phags pa yod pas/ khyis rmugs pa la'ang rdo mi brdeg par phyag thal mo sbyar nas mos gus mdzad pas/ rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ dge bshes mkhas pa khyod la nged kyi brgyud 'dzin re ba yin/ ngas chos 'di su la yang ma byin te/ khyod la ster ba yin gsungs nas gnang ngo*// chos rje rin po ches dpal phag mo gru pa'i drung du byon tsa na/

'o nga'i grwa pa da rdzogs gsungs nas shin tu mnyes skad/ zhal mnga' nas/ nga'i brgyud pa 'di dge bsnyen sa bcu pa zhig gis 'dzin pa yin gsungs nas/ grwa pa gzhan las thugs rtsis che bar mdzad nas/ gdams pa 'di gnang ba yin/ bla ma rin po ches/ ngas sngon chad gdams ngag 'di byin pa'i mi gsum las med gsungs/ su lags zhus pas/ seng ye dang*/ sher 'byung dang*/ khyod rang dang gsum yin gsungs/ gzhan la 'di yi gdams pa sna re tsam las ma byin gsungs nas bka' rgya mdzad/ de phyin nas gnang ba'i brgyud rim ni gzhung bzhin no// //gnyis pa dgos byed kyi gdams pa dngos la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dbang bzhis sgo dbye ba dang*/ dngos gzhi nyams len gyi chos bzhis gnad du bsnun pa dang*/ rjes phrin las tha dad du sgrub pa'i rim pa'o// dang po dbang bzhis sgo dbye ba la bzhi/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes tshig dbang ste/ dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ dkon mchog gi rten bkram/ mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad sta gon byas la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed/ rang nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom/ rgyal ba rim brtsegs bskyed/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang sems yi dam lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams gsal gdab/ bdag 'jug blang*/ thod pa'am rin po che'i snod du badz+ra yak+sha'i sngags kyis me tog sbyangs te/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros nas me tog la phog pas/ bla ma'i sku rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam par bskyed la/ brgyud pa'i gsang mtshan rnams ngag tu bgrang zhing*/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ me tog la thim par bsams la sta gon bya'o// de nas slob ma khrus bya/ bla ma la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul/ rang nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma bstan pa'i bdag por bsgom/ sems bskyed/ spyi bor rgyal ba rim brtsegs/ mdun du yi dam lha tshogs/ g.yas su sangs rgyas byang sems/

g.yon du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ rgyab tu chos skyong srung ma rnams brda sprad la bsgom du gzhug de nas dgongs su gsol ba'i skabs su mos gus bya/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i skabs su yid kyis lcogs tshad du sprul nas 'bul/ bshags pa'i skabs su 'gyod tshangs chen po bskyed par bya'o// ngag tu cho ga'i rjes zlos bya ba ni/ na mo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ byin rlabs dang ye shes kyi gter du gyur pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing yongs su dag pa/ rnam dag dbang gi gter du gyur pa'i yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa tshad med thugs rje'i gter du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rang bzhin dbyings na bzhugs pa dngos grub mchog gi gter du gyur pa ye shes ḍā ki'i tshogs srung ma dang bcas pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dngos dang dngos min 'khor 'das kyi zhing yongs su gang ba/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang*/ bdag dang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi rgyud tha dad kyis bsdus pa'i 'dod yon gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams mchod par 'bul lo// bzhes su gsol lo// thugs rjes dgongs su gsol lo// bdag gi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du bsags shing yod pa'i las ngan pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// zad cing srab pa dang*/ dag cing tshangs par mdzad du gsol lo// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ngo*// bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bskul ma 'debs so// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs par ma gyur gyi bar du/

bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi don du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol lo// 'di lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang*/ yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas rang gzhan thams cad bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas rgyal ba rim brtsegs ngo bo gcig pa la bsdus nas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas chos sku'i 'du shes bskyed la/ dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sems bskyed/ ngag tu bla ma rin po che chos kyi sku lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas/ ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag cing sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi gter du gyur pas/ bdag gi dug lnga dbyings su dag par bya ba'i phyir/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas de lta bu'i gzungs rab tu blangs nas/ rigs drug gi gnas na 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyis rab tu gzir ba'i sems can phan bde thar pa'i gnas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i byang chub kyi sems mngon du gyur pa bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gzhan gnyis kyi spyi bor rnam snang*/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ltag g.yas su rin 'byung*/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ltag g.yon par don grub rnams gsal gdab la/ mos gus dung nge byas pas/ dpral ba'i mi bskyod pa 'od du zhu ba dpral bar thim/ sgrib pa dag lus snang la rang bzhin med pa mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo 'od mthing gar gyur par bsam/ bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi dri ma dag me long lta bu'i ye shes shar/ bdag bla ma mi bskyod pa thugs rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du gyur ang snyam du nges shes bskyed/ rin 'byung 'od du zhu rna ltag g.yas su thim/ lus ser por gyur yon tan gyi dbang thob/

nga rgyal dag mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes shar/ bdag rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor gyur ang snyam du bsam/ 'od dpag med 'od du zhu/ ltag par thim lus dmar por gyur/ gsung gi dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag so sor rtog pa'i ye shes shar/ bdag gsung snang ba mtha' yas su gyur ang snyam du bsam/ don yod grub pa 'od du zhu/ rna ltag g.yon par thim/ lus 'od ljang khur gyur/ phrin las kyi dbang thob/ phrag dog dag bya ba grub pa'i ye shes shar/ bdag don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin du gyur ang snyam du bsam/ rnam snang 'od du zhu spyi bor thim/ lus rnam snang gi ngo bo 'od dkar por gyur/ sku'i dbang thob/ gti mug dag chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes shar/ bdag sku rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur ang snyam du bsam/ de nas/ rnam snang la sogs pa'i rigs lnga'i sa bon snang la rang bzhin med par gyur pa'i sku rnams las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad la phog bla ma'i sku dpag tu med par gyur/ de yang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ bla ma dam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bsam/ de nas bla mas rab gnas slob ma la gtor zhing*/ dpon slob gnyis kas bla ma'i sku dpag tu med pa slob ma'i lus la thim par bsam zhing*/ ngag tu bla ma rin po che'i sku'i byin rlabs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi gzungs rab tu thob nas/ sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba sems can gyi don byed par rab tu gnas par gyur cig bla ma rin po che'i gsung gi byin rlabs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas kyi so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi gzungs rab tu thob nas/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba sems can gyi don byed par rab tu gnas par gyur cig bla ma rin po che'i thugs kyi byin rlabs kyis bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi gzungs rab tu thob nas/

thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba sems can gyi don byed par rab tu gnas par gyur cig bla ma rin po che'i yon tan gyi byin rlabs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi gzungs rab tu thob nas/ yon tan mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba sems can gyi don byed par rab tu gnas par gyur cig bla ma rin po che'i phrin las kyi byin rlabs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi gzungs rab tu thob nas/ phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba sems can thams cad dang*/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la rab tu gnas par gyur cig shin tu rab tu gnas par gyur cig ces ye dharmā brjod/ des lus kyi sgrib pa dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ dam tshig tu snang ba thams cad bla ma'i skur shes par bgyi'o/// /gnyis pa gsang dbang la maṇ+ḍal phul/ rang bzhin ngo bo gcig par bsgoms pa'i spyi bor mi bskyod pa/ mgrin par snang ba mtha' yas/ snying khar rnam snang*/ lte bar rin 'byung*/ gsang gnas su don grub rnams bsgoms la/ bla ma rin po che chos kyi sku zhes pa'i gsol 'debs byas nas/ gsang gnas kyi bla ma nas rim gyis 'od 'phros slob ma'i gnas lngar bstim la/ gong ltar dag sbyar dang*/ rab gnas/ bla ma rin po che'i sku'i byin rlabs kyis/ zhes pa dang*/ yedharmā brjod/ mthar gnas lnga'i bla ma snying kha'i bla mar bsdus la/ snying kha'i bla ma 'od du zhu nas āḥzhes pa'i bla ma dam pa'i gsung gi sgra skye med grag stong du byung bas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par bsams la/ sgra de thos pa tsam gyi rang dang sems can gyi ngag gi dri ma dag par bsam zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor sangs rgyas nas gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'byung ba'i rten 'brel/

gsung gi sa bon zhes 'byung ba lags/ des gsang ba'i dbang thob pa sogs sbyar la bshad/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rang bzhin ngo bo gcig par bsgoms pa'i snying khar seng ges btegs pa'i khri sogs bkod la/ bla ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ phyogs bzhir mdun du oṃḥ g.yas su trāṃḥ rgyab tu hrīḥ g.yon du āḥrnams bkod la/ bla ma rin po che chos kyi sku zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sa bon rnams las 'od rim gyis byung*/ slob mar thim zhing dag sbyar dang rab gnas brjod/ de nas lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur nas bla ma'i sku la thim/ de'ang nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin du spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid du bsgom/ dam tshig tu snang ba thams cad bla ma'i thugs 'ba' zhig tu shes par bya/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa sogs brjod/ bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che la'ang maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gong ltar btab/ de nas bla mas rigs lnga spyi bsdus kyi phyag rgya slob ma la bstan la ngo sprod pa ni/ e ma ho/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu// ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// rang gi sems la tshur bltas pas// rang rig nyid du nyams su myong*// bsam med brjod pa'i yul las 'das// ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes brjod la ngo sprod pa ni/ e ma ho/ zhes pa ni 'bod pa'i brda'o// rang gi sems la bltas pas/ rang gi rig pa nyid blo las 'das par nyams su myong*/ de rtog dpyod kyi yul las 'das shing*/ rjod byed tshig gi yul las 'das par don ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ gdod ma nas skye ba med par stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'o// zhes tshig dbang rin po che ngo sprad pa'o// des dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/

'bras bu ngo bo nyid 'grub par byas so// de yang bla ma'i sku las dbang bzhi rdzogs par len pa 'di nyid rgyud sde thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ gdams ngag gi gnad mthar thug par gsungs shing*/ sa lam gyi rim pa ma lus par 'di nyid gcig pus bgrod par gsungs te/ mdo sde ye shes rgya mtsho las/ bla ma'i sku yi dkyil 'khor du// dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhus// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /sa lam gyi rim pa ma lus rdzogs// zhes gsungs pas/ dbang bzhi yis sgo dbye zhing chos sgo 'byed pa'o// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ dngos gzhi nyams len gyi chos bzhi la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang rnam pa gsum las/ sngon 'gro la bzhi ste/ sngon 'gro gnad la dbab pa bsags sbyang gnyis/ gsol 'debs mos gus kyi gter 'byed/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho/ bar bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bstan pa'o// dang po dben pa'i gnas su lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas ci bder 'dug sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de'i ched du bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa la 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed la/ bsod nams gsog pa'i rten du bla ma mtho brtsegs su bsgom/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug gi nam mkha'i mthongs su seng ge sngon po brgyad kyi khri'i steng du rin po che pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa mtshan dpes spras pa/ bdag la byin gyis rlob bzhin par bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i 'og tu rje btsun til+li pa chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba/ phyag g.yas seng ldeng gi ḍa ma ru g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams shing*/ he ru ka'i chas drug gis lus brgyan rus pa'i rgyan drug btung ba'i snod bde skyong ka pā la dang gzung bya'i rdzas yum kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

/rol mo'i ḍā ma ru dang gri rkang go cha stan kriṣ+ṇa sā ra'i lpags pa dang*/ bgo ba'i gos stag lpags// 'di dag he ru ka'i chas drug ste// rnam par phye na bcu bzhir 'gyur ba'o// zhes pas brgyan cing*/ zhabs rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ bdag la byin gyis rlob bzhin par bsgom/ de'i 'og tu bla ma nā ro pa chen po de nyid kyang*/ sku mdog smug nag phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ he ru ka'i chas drug gi spras pa/ zhabs rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ bdag la byin gyis rlob bzhin par bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i 'og tu bla ma mar pa lo tsā de nyid sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i cha byad can/ dbu skra nag la li ba/ spyan rtsa dmar la zlum pa/ phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ sku la ras cham dang dar cham gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje dkyil krung seng ge'i khri la bzhugs shing*/ bdag la byin gyis rlob bzhin du bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i 'og tu bla ma mi la ras chen de nyid sku mdog dkar dmar mdangs dang ldan pa/ dbu skra nag la spyan rtsa dmar ba/ snyan long dung dang*/ ras dkar dang dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ phyag g.yas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis chos ston pa'i 'gram pa skyor zhing*/ g.yon pa ba men gyi rwa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs phyed pa'i dkyil krung du bzhugs pa/ mchod phyir sgom thag thogs pa/ bdag la byin gyis rlob bzhin du bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i 'og tu bla ma rin po che mnyam med sgam po pa chen po de nyid sku mdog dkar ba/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ gsung yan lag drug cu sogs stong phrag brgyad cus chos ston pa/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya phrag du ma la snyoms par 'jug pa/ phyag sa gnon mnyam bzhag

lhung bzed rin po ches gang ba g.yon pas 'dzin pa/ sku la gur gum ku sha ri'i chos gos gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu la ka rtags kyi phyag rgya sgom zhwa gsol ba/ mchod phyir thogs pa'am sangs rgyas rol pa zhes sgom thag bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung gi seng ges btegs pa'i khri la bzhugs shing*/ bdag la byin gyis rlob par bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i 'og tu rje phag mo gru pa/ chos rje 'jig rten gsum mgon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje rgyal po/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po/ bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ mnyam med rin chen chos kyi rgyal po rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan mnyam med sgam po pa lta bu bsgom/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bstan pa'i bdag po sprul sku shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ dbu'i gtsug gtor bltar mi mngon pa sku la gur gum ku sha ri'i chos gos rnam gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed rin po ches bkang ba bsnams pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing*/ zhabs rdo rje dkyil krung gis bzhugs par bsgom pa la/ yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyis bskor ba'i skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bsgoms la/ tshogs gsag pa ni dgu rnam dag sngon du 'gro bas/ dang po sku blta ba'i mchod pa ni/ bdag 'di dag dang mjal ba re dga' snyam ste/ mos gus 'bul ba/ de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rje na moḥ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la bstod par bgyi// zhes dang*/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba'i mchod pa rang gi lus 'di zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas/

na mo gu ru/ bud+dha dharmāḥsaṃ gha bo dhi satwa bh+yaḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ phyi'i mchod pa rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil sogs dwangs shing thogs pa med pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rnams kyis mchod/ nang gi mchod pa snying kha'i sa bon las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du/ lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma/ sgra rdo rje ma/ dri rdo rje ma/ ro rdo rje ma/ reg bya rdo rje ma/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma la sogs pas bde stong gi mchod pa phul bar bsam/ gsang ba'i mchod pa/ mchod bya mchod byed/ mchod yul rnams mi dmigs pa dwangs rang dwangs/ bla na med pa don gyi mchod pas mchod/ sdig pa bshags pa rang gzhan thams cad kyi sdig pa bshags/ phyis mi byed par dam bca'/ rang gzhan so skye nyan rang byang sems/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang*/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ma 'debs/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs par ma gyur gyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ rang gzhan gyi dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o// zhes ltos med kyis mchod na de la bsod nams dpag tu med par gsungs te/ gsang 'dus las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mchod las// bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod mchog /de yi bsod nams khyad par 'phags// zhes dang*/ sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs la// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// go 'phang mchog ni thob par 'gyur// bla med mdzad pa'i slob dpon ni// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod na// de yis bsod nams ma bsags shing*// dka' thub ma bsten ci zhig yod// gsungs pas 'di ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/// /sbyang ba ni/

rgyal ba rim brtsegs ngo bo gcig pa la bsdus pa'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ dkar la 'tsher ba bsgom/ de las rnam dag bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar nar re bab nas/ rtsa dbu ma rdo rje'i bu ga nas thon/ rang gi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas bab pas/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad sangs dag nas/ dri chen dri chu'i lam dang*/ sor mo'i rtse rnams dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas nag nu ru ru bud par bsam zhing bla ma'i yi ge brgya pa 'di ltar bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra gu ru twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaṃḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra gu ru mā me muñtsa/ badz+ri gu ru bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā'aḥ zhes rtags ma byung gi bar du bzlas shing*/ thun mtshams su bla ma rang la bstim/ bsags sbyang gnyis snga ma la skyo na phyi ma nyams su blang*/ phyi ma la skyo na snga ma nyams su blang*/ ldang ba'i dus su 'khor gsum rnam dag gi bsngo ba re mdzod/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba ni/ skyabs yul bla ma mtho brtsegs gong ltar gsal gdab/ dgu rnam dag phul nas/ bdag gzhan khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan zhing*/

rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes dkon mchog gi yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro byed/ 'dod don du gsol ba 'debs/ tshogs rten rang la bstim la/ thun mtshams ngal bso'i rim pa la bzhag go// yang tshogs rten rgyal ba rim brtsegs sogs tshang bar bsgoms la/ dgu rnam dag byas la maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ sems can gyi don du/ oṃ badz+ra bhū me āḥhūm̐/ gzhi dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa/ byur bur gang ba kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu bkod pa 'di nyid dang bdag gi lus longs spyod dang*/ kha rje dbang thang mthu nus pa rdzas yo byad/ yul ris dang rgyal khams/ phyi nang gsang gsum de kho na nyid mchod pa dang bcas pa 'di nyid bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro/ rgyud srung ḍā ki'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag la mos gus dang rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sa gzhi spos sogs dang*/ 'dod don du gsol ba btab/ tshogs rten rang la bstim la mnyam par gzhag go// de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ spyi bor rgyal ba rim brtsegs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bstan pa'i bdag po'i bar tshang bar bsgom la/ ming gzhan gsang ba ye shes mchog gi gsol 'debs sam/ gsol 'debs mos gus kyi gter 'byed// nam mkha' dbyings kyi gsol 'debs kyang zer/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho gnyis bya ste/ mos gus kyi gter kha 'byed cing yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye ba lags/

gsol 'debs gnyis po 'di bzung na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po bzung ba yin/ 'di thos pa dang dran pa tsam gyis ngan song gsum du mi 'gro ba kho bos yon len pa yin gsungs/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlob cing*/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du mi 'bral ba lags gsungs pas/ brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su blangs te de'i gsol 'debs ni/ na moḥ dus gsum 'khor 'das kyi rgyud yongs su gang ba bla ma rin po che'i sku gsung thugs chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyun chad med pa dang*/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer mi phyed cing*/ tha mi dad pa'i chos kyi sku dang 'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus dang*/ rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa da lta nyid du skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ rang sems dmigs pa'i yul dang phral la spros med kyi ngang nas 'og ma'ang bya ste/ de'i gsol 'debs ni/ rje yid bzhin nor bu gtsug gi rgyan// smra bsam brjod med rgyal ba'i thugs// mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga dang ldan// brtse ba'i bdag nyid thugs rje can// 'gro ba skyob mdzad rin po che// bdag sems nyid kyi ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// chos nyid ngang nas byin gyis rlobs// sems gdod nas skye med rnam dag 'di// blo 'das chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba gdab pas/ gdung shugs kyi mos gus drag po skye ba lags te/ 'di'i skabs su lus kyis phyag dang bskor ba/ ngag gis gsol ba 'debs/ yid kyis mos gus lcogs tshad du 'bul/ de ltar bla ma rnams kyi thugs bum sku lta bu kha phye ba'i nang nas rdo rje 'chang man chad dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi ngo bo ye shes lnga ldan 'od zer dkar po rgyun mi 'chad par byung bas/ rang gzhan gyi lus ngag yid gsum la phog pas mos gus kyi rtogs pa rgyud la lam lam 'char bar bsam mo// brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su blang*/

ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba bya'o// de nas dbang bzhi len pa ni/ rgyal ba rim brtsegs ngo bo gcig par bsdus la/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs/ bla mar bstim kun 'dus su bsams la/ chos sku 'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus kyis gsol 'debs gnyis po byas pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag bum pa'i dbang thob par bsam/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po byung*/ rang gi mgrin par thim gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ de nas bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med tu gyur pa'i ngang nas sems ma bcos par bzhag tshig dbang rin po che thob par bsgom/ ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba bya'o// de ltar zab pa'i gdams pa 'di lta bu nyams su blangs pas/ shin tu bar chad sdang bas te/ gang tshe chos nyid don la mnyam par sus bzhag pa// de tshe bdud tshogs mi dga' cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston// zhes dang*/ mdo sdud pa las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang*// theg par gsar du zhugs pa'i sems can blo chung ba// gang zhig dkon pa'i rin chen 'di ni ma rnyed pa// de la bar chad bya phyir bdud ni spro bar 'gyur// zhes pas/ phyi rol mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar chad/ nang 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad/ gsang ba sems kyi zug rngu'i bar chad la sogs pa 'byung nye bas/ de la bar chad bzlog cing bogs 'don pa ni/

bar bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bstan pa 'di yin te/ gzhi gnam sa ga'u kha sbyor gyis lus kyi bar chad bsrung ba/ ā li kā lis ngag gi bar chad bsrung ba/ 'od gsal gyis sems kyi bar chad bsrung ba/ gnas gnyis su 'byung ba tsha grang gi rten gnyis gnas pas des 'byung ba mi 'khrug cing*/ bar chad mi 'byung ba lags/ de'i nyams len 'di ltar bya ste/ bla ma'i sku las dbang bzhi blangs rang la bstims nas/ rang gi 'og tu 'byung ba sa'i ngo bo rin po che gser las grub pa'i 'khor lo ga'u'i dbyibs lta bu zhig bsam/ steng du 'byung ba nam mkha'i ngo bo rin po che dngul las grub pa'i 'khor lo ga'u'i dbyibs lta bu/ yar mar bkab pa lta bur bsams la/ de gnyis bsgrigs pa'i nang du rang gi lus dngos por grub pa med pa stong pa nyid du bsams la/ ga'u'i ma gdan raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar kyil le ba zhig bsam pa'i dbus su/ āḥdamar po'i mtha' mar/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ ta tha da dha ṇa/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ rnams lcags sreg gi mdog lta bu dmar ram me ba g.yon du 'khor bar bsam/ ga'u'i ya kheb kyi dbus su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba lta bu dkar kyil le ba zhig bsams pa'i dbus su haṃ dkar po'i mthar mar a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ā+ai/ o ā+au/ aṃ āḥ rnams dung gi mdog lta bu'i nyis 'gyur du g.yas skor du dkar ram me 'khor bar bsam/ de gnyis kyi dbus rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ 'phra sbom mda' smyug tsam 'ja'i rnam pa lta bu/ yar sne haṃ la zug pa/ mar sne a la zug pa zhig bsam zhing*/ de'i dbus snying ga'i thad du hūm̐ sngon po gcig la bka' brgyud bla ma'i gsang mtshan gyis bskor ba bsgoms la bzlas pa byas pas/ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga'i 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas ga'u'i nang thams cad 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pas khrigs se khengs par bsams la/

gsang mtshan bzlas mnyam par bzhag go// thun mtshams su rang gi lus dkrong gi byung*/ ga'u'i ya khebs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ā li dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas spyi bo'i haṃ la thim/ ga'u'i ma khebs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kā li dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas gsang gnas kyi ā la thim nas srog 'khor gyi dmigs pa ma yengs pa'i ngang nas/ gsang ba ye shes mchog gi gsol 'debs dang*/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi gsol 'debs gnyis byas pas/ sgo gsum la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ dmigs pa gsal zhing bogs thon pa'i dgos pa yod/ nges don la sbyar na lus yi dam lha snang stong zung 'jug bsgom pa ni gnam sa ga'u kha sbyor gyis lus kyi bar chad bsrung ba yin/ de tha mal du song ba 'am/ snang stong ya bral na kha sbyor ma yin te lus bar chad kyi dbang du song ba'o// ngag gi sgra grag stong dbyer med zung 'jug tu bsgom pa ni/ ā li kā lis ngag gi bar chad bsrung ba yin te/ de grag stong ya bral ba'am/ rlung rig dbyer med ma shes na ā li kā li ma yin te/ ngag bar chad kyi dbang du song ba'o// yid bla ma'i thugs rig stong zung 'jug tu bsgom pa ni 'od gsal gyis yid kyi bar chad bsrung ba yin te/ de tha mal du song ba'am rig stong ya bral na 'od gsal ma yin te/ yid bar chad kyi dbang du song ba'o// de nas sku gsung thugs la 'khyer so gsum dang ma bral zhing tha mal dang*/ ya bral gyis bar ma chod pa zhig dgos so// ༈ //dngos gzhi nyams len gyi chos bzhis gnad du bsnun pa la/ phyi sgrub sprul sku phrin las su bsgrub pa/ nang sgrub longs sku yon tan du bsgrub pa/ gsang sgrub chos sku gnyis med tu bsgrub pa/ de kho na nyid ngo bo nyid du bsgrub pa dang bzhi/ dang por bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brten dgos te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa legs gnas shing*// rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams kyi// thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// skas kyi gdang bu lta bur gsungs// zhes pas/

bskyed rim lhan skyes dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom/ rdzogs rim phra thig gi rnal 'byor rtsa rlung sogs sprul sku sangs rgyas su bsgrub pa'o// dang po bskyed rim la rje btsun til+li pa'i zhal nas/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// zhes pas/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs byang chub pa lnga la brten te bskyed rim bsgom pas so// de yang kyai rdo rje las/ zla ba ye shes me long ldan// rta bdun po las mnyam nyid ldan// rang lha'i sa bon phyag mtshan ni// so sor rtog par brjod par bya// thams cad gcig gyur bya nan tan// rdzogs pa chos dbyings dag pa ste// mkhas pas cho gar gsungs pa yi// rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa nyid// ces dang por gzhi stong pa nyid las byang chub pa/ gdan nyi zla las byang chub pa/ gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste/ mngon byang lngas bskyed do// de nyid 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa bsgom pa don dam byang chub kyi sems te/ gzhi stong pa nyid do// stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ suṃ las ri rab lhun po/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gdan nyi zla de'i steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du wa ler gyur pa ni sku yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de ltar rang nyid he ru ka yab sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

dbu skra ral pa bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ logs g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal rus pa'i rgyan drug dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan dang 'jigs byed mnan pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo rtsa zhal khro zhal rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog pa/ dbu skra spyi bor bcings shing gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal phyag rgya lnga dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang lhan cig tu brkyang zhing*/ g.yas yab kyi sked la 'khril ba gzhon zhing mdzes pas 'khyud par bsgom/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dang*/ baṃ las 'od 'phros bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bsgom/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rang la bstim pas lus bdag byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba'i phung po la rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'du byed kyi phung po la rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po la rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ yum gyi lte bar rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar gshin rje ma sngon mo/ mgrin par rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo bor skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la tsan+ḍi ka dud kha bsgom/ ngag bdag byin gyis brlabs pa/

yab yum gyi snying po bzla bar bya ste/ yab kyi snying po/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ nye snying ni/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi snying po/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nā ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ nye snying ni/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas par bya'o// bzlas brjod grub nas/ phyi sgrub dmigs pa gzhung bsgom pa 'di ltar bya ste/ rang lhar gsal ba'i khong pa'i nang thams cad stong par bsgom/ rtsa dbu ma yar sna tshangs bug mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa khang stong du ka ba btsugs pa lta bu bsgom/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis/ mgrin par bcu drug snying khar brgyad/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi/ gsang gnas su lnga rnams pad+ma kha gyen du phyogs pa ltar bsgom la/ spyi bor rtsa 'dab steng du seng ge dang rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du bla ma mi bskyod pa sngon po longs sku'i rgyan can du bsgom/ mgrin par yang gdan bkod pa mchog dang ldan pa'i spo la/ bla ma snang ba mtha' yas sprul skur bsgom/ snying khar gdan gong bzhin gyi steng du bla ma rnam par snang mdzad longs skur bsgom/ lte bar gdan gong bzhin gyi steng du/ bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan sprul skur bsgom/ gsang gnas su gdan bkod pa mchog dang ldan pa'i steng du/ bla ma don yod grub pa longs sku rgyan can du bsgom/ de nas dang por gsang gnas kyi bla ma gsal gdab/ bdun rnam dag gi mchod pa dge rtsa maṇ+ḍal phul/ mos gus drag po'i sgo nas gsang ba ye shes mchog gi gsol 'debs dang*/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi gsol 'debs byed/ gsang mtshan gyi bzlas pa byas pas/ bla ma don yod grub pa'i sku las 'od zer ljang khu byung khong pa'i nang thams cad khengs/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog gi dri ma dag

don yod grub pa'i sku til gyi gang bu ltar bsam/ de'i gnas lnga nas 'od zer sna lnga 'phros/ brtan g.yo thams cad de lta bu'i skur gyur/ de rnams bla ma'i sku dang dbyer med tu bsgom/ gsol 'debs gnyis po gong ltar bya/ de nas phyi'i bla ma rnams nang bcud kyi bla ma la bstim/ de thams cad kyang rang gi ba spu'i bu gar zhugs te rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes shar/ bdag bla ma don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur ang snyam du bsgom zhing mnyam par bzhag ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba bya'o// yang lte ba'i bla ma gsal btab/ mchod 'bul gsol 'debs bzlas pa byas pas 'od zer ser po byung*/ lus gang nga rgyal gyi dri ma dag de'i gnas lnga nas 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros/ brtan g.yo thams cad bla ma'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus lte bar thim/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes shar/ bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag bsngo ba bya/ yang snying khar gsal gdab/ mchod 'bul gsol 'debs bzlas pa byas pas/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer dkar po byung lus gang*/ gti mug gi dri ma dag brtan g.yo thams cad bla ma'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes shar/ bdag bla ma rnam par snang mdzad tu gyur pa sogs bya/ yang mgrin pa'i bla ma gsal gdab mchod 'bul gsol 'debs bzlas pa byas pas/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer dmar po 'phros lus gang*/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag gnas lnga las 'od zer 'phros brtan g.yo thams cad bla ma'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes shar/ bdag bla ma snang ba mtha' yas su gyur pa sogs bya'o// yang spyi bo'i bla ma gsal btab/ mchod 'bul gsol 'debs bzlas pa byas pas/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ brtan g.yo thams cad bla ma'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus me long lta bu'i ye shes shar/ bdag bla ma mi bskyod pa sngon por gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag

bsngo ba bya'o// de nas gnas lnga'i bla ma gsal btab nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma mgrin pa'i bla ma la bstim/ gsang gnas kyi bla ma lte ba'i bla ma la bstim/ mgrin pa'i bla ma snying ga'i bla ma la bstim/ lte ba'i bla ma yang snying kha'i bla ma la bstim la/ snying ga'i bla ma gsal btab la dmigs pa ma yengs pa'i ngang nas/ mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gong ltar gsol ba btab/ ched du bcos te mos gus bya ba ni/ lus kyis mchi ma 'khrug ngag gi gsol 'debs/ yid kyi mos gus dung dung pa zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bskyed par bya'o// de ltar byas pas dang po zhen pa'i mos gus skye/ de nas bzod thabs med pa'i mos gus zug dang bcas pa 'char/ mos gus de la shes pa rtse gcig tu song na/ nyin mtshan skyo dub med par 'byung ba khyad par gyi gnad yin gsungs/ mos gus kyi gdams pa 'dis rigs lnga sprul sku'i ngo bor sangs rgyas nas/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los/ gang la gang 'dul sems can gyi don lhun grub tu 'byung ba yang*/ khyad par du gdams pa 'di'i gnad las byung ba yin te/ brgyud pa rin po che 'di la yod pa yin/ dper na phyi rol tu snang srid thams cad lhar 'char ba sku lnga ye shes lnga'i byed pa las byung ba yin/ des na phyi nang gnad gcig pa yin pas/ snang sems zung 'jug 'ba' zhig tu gnas pa las/ don rtags ni thun mong ma yin pa'i mos gus skye ba dang*/ sgom rtse gcig rgyud la 'char ba yin/ mtshan rtags ni me tog gi ljongs chen po dang*/ rin po che'i thang dang*/ nam mkha' dwangs pa la nyi zla shar ba dang*/ me tog dang 'bras bu'i phung po la sogs pa'i ltas khyad par can rnams nyams sam rmi lam la 'byung ngo*// de dag ni bla ma'i sgrub tshul bstan pa/ phyi sgrub sprul sku phrin las su sgrub pa thon chos dang bcas pa tshar ba lags/ ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba bya'o//

༈ //na mo rat+na gu ru/ spyi don gnyis pa nang sgrub longs sku yon tan du bsgrub pa la gsum yin te/ gsang mtshan thugs kyi nor bu/ gsang mtshan 'khor 'das dbang sdud/ gsang mtshan thugs kyi 'khor lo dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ gzhi gdod ma nas thugs ka 'di bla ma dam pa'i pho brang du gnas la/ de las bla ma dam pa bsgom pa'i dus su snying rtse mo gyen la log nas/ bla ma dam pa'i pho brang gsang ba bum sku kha phye ba bzhin du 'byung ba lags/ gnad 'dis mos gus mi skye mi srid pa yin gsungs/ de la nang longs sku'i 'khor lo la brten nas/ phyi sprul sku nang longs skus ngo sprod pa ste/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud las/ phyi rol ji bzhin nang de bzhin// sdom pa'i dbye ba rab tu bshad// ces/ sdom pa 'khor lo bshad pa'i dus su phyi nang thams cad sdom par gnad gcig de'ang rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo gzhi gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa rtsa rlung thig le'i rang bzhin du gnas pa 'di rang rtsa ba'i bla ma lags/ de ltar bla ma dam pa rang gi lus la gnas pas phyi rol du grub pa med/ 'o na phyi rol gyi bla ma de ci yin snyam na/ nang du de ltar du gnas pas phyi rol du yang de ltar grub pa yin te/ phyi rol du bla ma la seng ge brgyad kyi khri byung ba yang*/ nang du snying gi dbus na sman bu chung seng ge'i dbyibs su chags pa brgyad yod pas byung ba yin/ phyi rol du bla ma la rin po che'i khri byung ba yang*/ nang du nor bu rin po che'i khams kyi dwangs ma snying gi dbus na yod pa yin no// phyi ru pad+ma'i gdan byung ba/ nang du rtsa bo che brgyad pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi tshul du yod pas so// phyi ru nyi zla'i gdan 'byung ba/ nang du dkar tshil zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gnas pas zla gdan dang*/ dmar tshil nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gnas pas nyi gdan byung ba yin/ de'i steng du/ rang gi lus kyi rten rtsa'i dwangs ma zla zer gyi rnam pa/

yig 'bru'i tshul du gnas pa ni sku/ de'i nang du gsal zhing dwangs pa'i rlung rgyu ba ni gsung*/ bde stong zag med kyi thig le ni thugs/ de las lus kyi rtsa phran thams cad gyes pas gdul bya rigs mi 'dra ba mang po 'byung ba yang de yin/ 'di shin tu zab pa yin te/ snying gi dbus na rig pa ye shes hūm̐ du gnas pa'i dwangs ma gsum ni/ rtsa'i dwangs ma/ dwangs ma'i dwangs ma/ shin tu dwangs ma/ rlung gi dwangs ma/ dwangs ma'i dwangs ma/ shin tu dwangs ma/ thig le'i dwangs ma/ dwangs ma'i dwangs ma/ shin tu dwangs ma ste/ de la dwangs ma gsum ni bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum mo// rtsa'i dwangs ma mi rtog pa'i ngo bo/ bde gsal gyi cha ma dor ba'o// shin tu dwangs ma ni rig stong 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'o// rlung gi dwangs ma ni gsal ba'i ngo bor bde stong gi cha ma dor ba'o// shin tu dwangs ma ni gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mngon tu gyur pa'o// thig le'i dwangs ma ni bde ba'i ngo bo gsal stong gi cha ma dor ba'o// shin tu dwangs ma ni bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'o// de ltar rtsa rlung thig le bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs su shes par byas la/ nyams len ni sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bskyed/ rang gi snying gi dbus su gong ltar gdan bkod pa gsal btab pa'i steng du/ bla ma dam pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag gcig bsgom/ phyogs bzhir oṃ trāṃḥhrīḥ.āḥbazhi so so'i kha dog dang bcas pa g.yas bskor du bskyed/ mtshams bzhir/ lāṃ tāṃ pāṃ māṃ bzhi g.yon skor du bskyed/ de nas bla ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ las ye shes lnga'i 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros/ khong pa'i nang thams cad khengs par bsam zhing*/ brgyud pa'i gsang mtshan rnams dkar ram me g.yas bskor nas yod par bsam/ mchod 'bul gsol 'debs byas la/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon/

gu ru badz+ra dhṛ ka sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje 'chang dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru pra dzñā bha dra sid+dhi pha la bla ma shes rab bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru dzñā na sid+dhi pha la bla ma ye shes dngos grub dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru dharma ma ti sid+dhi pha la bla ma chos kyi blo gros bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru badz+ra dh+wa dza sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru puṇ+ye rat+na sid+dhi pha la bla ma bsod nams rin chen dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru badz+ra rā dza sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje rgyal po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon/ gu ru rat+na shrī bha dra sid+dhi pha la bla ma rin chen dpal bzang po grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru puṇ+ye kīrti sid+dhi pha la bla ma bsod nams grags dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐ḥ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung sa bon gu ru badz+ra kīrti sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje grags dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru rat+na singha sid+dhi pha la bla ma rin chen seng ge dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/

oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru kīrti puṇ+ye sid+dhi pha la bla ma grags pa bsod nams dngos grub bzang po stsol/ hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon/ gu ru badz+ra rat+na sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje rin chen dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru badz+ra rā dza sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje rgyal po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru dharma rā dza sid+dhi pha la bla ma chos kyi rgyal po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru ar+tha rā dza sid+dhi pha la bla ma don grub rgyal po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru ga ga dh+wa dzaḥsid+dhi pha la bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru wā gī shwa raḥdh+wa dzaḥsid+dhi pha la bla ma ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru wā gī shwa raḥkīrti sid+dhi pha la bla ma ngag dbang grags pa dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru rat+na dharma rā dza shrī bha dra sid+dhi pha la bla ma rin chen chos kyi rgyal po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru ā nan+da rat+na dharma dh+wa dza shrī bha dra sid+dhi pha la bla ma kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon zhes bzlas/

de las skyo na gsang mtshan rnams phyogs mtshams kyi sa bon brgyad la thim/ sa bon rnams kyang bla ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ du gnas pa la thim/ hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar thim pa la ngo lta bya ste/ dran pa rgyag ro snyoms byed/ re dogs phral la bzhag go// ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba bya'o// gnyis pa gsang mtshan 'khor 'das dbang sdud ni/ rang gi snying gar seng ge'i khri nas nyi zla'i bar bskyed pa'i steng du/ bla ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ dang phyogs bzhir sa bon bzhi dang*/ gsang mtshan rnams bskyed la/ mchod pa dgu rnam dag gsol 'debs gnyis byas/ gsang mtshan bzlas pas/ hūm̐ las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros brtan g.yo thams cad la phog thams cad rgyal ba rigs lngar gyur/ tshur 'dus rang rang gi sa bon la thim/ slar yang mdun gyi oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ shar phyogs kyi zhing khams khyab/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa thams cad la phog spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan brtan g.yo'i bcud thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags bsdus pa lta bur gyur nas sa bon la thim zhing*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par byas/ yang g.yas kyi trāṃḥlas 'od zer ser po 'phros/ lho phyogs kyi zhing khams khyab/ rin chen 'byung ldan la sogs pa thams cad la phog spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan brtan g.yo'i bcud thams cad bsdus/ sa bon la thim zhing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par byas/ yang rgyab kyi hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros/ nub phyogs kyi zhing khams khyab/ 'od dpag med la sogs pa'i gnas su phog spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yo tan brtan g.yo'i bcud thams cad bsdus/ sa bon la thim zhing mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob par byas/ yang g.yon gyi āḥljang khu las 'od zer 'phros/ byang phyogs kyi zhing khams khyab/ don yod grub pa la sogs pa thams cad la phog spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan brtan g.yo'i bcud thams cad bsdus sa bon la thim zhing*/

mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob par byas/ 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du 'du ba lags/ srog gi 'khor lo gnad la dbab pas mi 'du mi srid pa yin/ de nas shar phyogs kyi zhing khams g.yo zhing rdo rje'i rigs dbang du bsdud/ lho phyogs g.yo zhing rin chen rigs/ nub phyogs g.yo zhing pad+ma'i rigs/ byang phyogs g.yo zhing las kyi rigs dbang du bsdus te/ mos gus kyi gnad 'dis longs spyod rdzogs sku'i ngo bor sangs rgyas nas/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi gdul bya rnams smin grol la 'god pa yin gsungs/ gdams pa 'di'i gnad yod na longs spyod rdzogs sku rgyan can du mchis te/ gdul bya zhing khams dpag tu med pa la mnga' mdzad pa lags/ des na zhing sbyong ba'i gnad 'di shin tu gal che bas/ nan tan che bar byed dgos pa yin/ ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba mdzod/ gsum pa gsang mtshan thugs kyi 'khor lo ni/ rang gi thugs seng ge rin po che dang pad+ma 'dab brgyad nyi zla'i dbus su/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa de'i steng du phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas su bla ma dam pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag tu bsam pa ni rdo rje'i sku yin pas rigs mi 'gyur ba'i rtags so// de'i phyogs bzhir rigs lnga'i sa bon/ de'i phyi rol gyi rtsibs rnams la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsang mtshan/ rtsibs mchan la yi dam yab yum gyi gzungs sngags bkod la/ phrin las rlung gi bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rlung g.yas su rgyu ba dang bstun nas g.yas su 'khor ba la dmigs nas bzlas na/ g.yas me rlung gis dbang gi las 'grub/ rlung g.yon nas rgyu ba dang bstun nas g.yon du 'khor ba la dmigs nas bzlas na/ g.yon rlung gi rlung gis drag po'i las 'grub/ cha mnyam du rgyu ba dang bstun nas g.yas skor g.yon skor du bzlas na/ cha mnyam chu rlung gis zhi ba'i las 'grub/ cha mnyam shin tu dal bar rgyu ba dang bstun te/

g.yas 'khor g.yon 'khor du dmigs nas bzlas na/ dal bar rgyu ba la sa rlung gis rgyas pa'i las 'grub/ de ni go rim gyi 'khor lo ste/ stod byang chub lam du 'khyer ba'i man ngag go// smad phrin las lam du 'khyer ba go bzlog gi 'khor lo 'di las thams cad rno zhing myur ba yin te/ 'di cung gnyan grags pas zhal las shes par bya'o// phun sum tshogs pa thig le ye shes kyi khrid ni sa bon yi ge bzhi'i nang na/ so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i bdud rtsi khol lud cing gang bar bsgom na rnal 'byor pa de gang du sdod kyang phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu 'byung ba dang*/ yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ba las/ srog gi 'khor lo 'dis bla ma srog tu 'gro ba/ bla ma dbang du 'du ba/ bla mas byin gyis rlob pa/ 'khor mos gus can 'du ba/ rgyud la ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rtogs pa skye ba lags/ da ni mos gus bogs 'don zhing rtsal sbyong ste/ mos gus ma skyes pa skye ba'i thabs rnam pa gsum ste/ dang por mos gus dbang du bsdu ba ni/ dus gsum gyi bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad mos gus gcig pu'i ngo bor sangs ma rgyas pa med pas/ de dag gi byin rlabs dang mos gus thams cad bsdus nas/ rang rgyud la sib sib thim par yang yang bsam/ des skye ba'i thabs yin/ gnyis pa rang rgyud la skyon du lta ba ni/ bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas yin pa la/ nga la mos gus med pas lan bsam zhing*/ skyon du bltas la tshar bcad pas/ yid skyo ba skyes pa ci zhig ltar na/ shes pa bun long gi song nas/ gang nas byung cha med pa'i mos gus zhig 'byung ba lags/ yang shes pa gsos 'debs pa ni/ bla ma'ang sangs rgyas yin/ nga rang la yang mos gus yod/ gdams ngag 'di lta bu thob bsam zhing*/ sems gzengs bstod cing spro ba bskyed pas mos gus ma skyes pa skye zhing ngar thon pa lags/ mos gus 'byung tshul gsum ni/

dang po sha rus pa'i gting nas zug rngu dang bcas pa bzod thabs med par lus srog brgyal ba tsam 'byung*/ gnyis pa dga' bde'i mos gus ni/ sems rgyun chad med par shes pa dga' yal gyi song nas sems zug rngu dang bral te/ rang la yid ches shing rang gis rang mthong ba'i nges shes 'byung ngo*// 'di'i skabs su bar chad 'byung nyen yod pas gzob pa dang*/ rig pa gnon pa gal che gsungs/ gsum pa rang rdol gyi mos gus 'byung ba'am/ yang na rkyen gyis bskyed pa ste/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po rgya mtsho rlabs kyis bskyod pa lta bu gting nas g.yos pas/ mos gus kyis shes pa bun long gis song ba'i dus su/ rig pa spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral te/ ci yin cha med pa'i mos gus shig skye/ nga'i nyams 'di ci yin snyam pa dang*/ dbang po yang mi 'dug snyam pa 'byung*/ de yang bla ma dam pas ngo sprad pa'i chos nyid der 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes dang mos gus lhag par yang skye/ de rlung sems kyi byed las yin gsungs/ des na don rtags ni spros bral gyi rtogs pa dang mos gus skye ba/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha tshogs zhal mthong ba dang nyams bzang po 'byung*/ mtshan rtags ni snag tsha 'thung ba dang*/ yi ge'i tshogs mid pa dang*/ klog pa dang*/ bla ma'i gsung sgra thos pa dang*/ chos nyan bshad byed pa dang*/ lus kyi nang yi ges khengs pa dang*/ rin po che'i zhing khams rnams su phyin pa la sogs pa ltas khyad par can 'byung ba yin gsungs/ des nang sgrub longs sku yon tan du sgrub pa thon chos dang bcas pa song ba lags/ ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba re mdzod// ༈ //na mo gu ru spyi don gsum pa gsang sgrub chos sku gnyis med du sgrub pa la/ gsang sgrub rnam dag ngo sprod/ gsang sgrub chos sku ngo sprod/ chos sku 'khor 'das dbyer med dang gsum las/ dang por bla ma dam pa chos kyi skur shes dgos te/

bla ma dam pa las gzhan pa'i chos sku med/ chos sku las gzhan pa'i bla ma med/ des na rang sems dag pa chos kyi sku bla ma dam pa lags/ de yin pa la yin par shes dgos te/ rang sems bla ma'i mtshan nyid ci lta bu zhe na/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ gang zhig lhun grub brjod bral 'dus ma byas// kha sbyor bde chen longs sku gang 'dul shar// sku gsum don bdun rdo rje 'chang chen lags// zhes pas/ dang po tshig rkang gong ma'i don/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa// mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan// don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// thog ma dbus mtha' med pa ru// rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas// zhi ba chos kyi sku can phyir// lhun gyis grub ces bya bar brjod// ces pa'i don no// rkang pa bar pa kha sbyor zhes pa dang*/ rkang pa gsum pa sku gsum zhes pa'i don rnams yan lag bdun ldan la tshang ste/ dang po kha sbyor gyi yan lagabade ba chen po'i yan lag rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag snying rjes yongs su gang ba'i yan lag rgyun mi 'chad pa'i yan lag 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag dang bdun no// dang po kha sbyor ni/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po dang*/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid sbyor ba'o// gnyis pa bde ba chen po zhes pa/ 'dzag med kyi ye shes/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbu'i nor bus mtshon pa'i phyir mi ldog gi ye shes/ srid pa'i gzigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i don no// gsum pa rang bzhin med pa zhes pa zag med kyi yon tan/ rnam thar za ma tog las/ de ni srid zhi'i yul la gnas mi mnga'// zag med yon tan phung po'i rgyan dang ldan// dbang bskur rgyal po sbyor ba'i mchog sbyin pa// dus gsum sems can grol bar bzhugs pa lags// zhes pa'i don no// bzhi pa snying rjes yongs su gang ba ni/

mngon rtogs rgyan las/ srid pas bde la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa// zhes pas/ zhi ba'i dbyings las bzhengs te/ snying rje zung 'jug gis gzhan don byed pa'i don no// lnga pa rgyun mi 'chad pa zhes gzhi lam 'bras gsum mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor gdod nas 'gyur ba med par gnas pa la dgongs te/ theg chen rgyud bla ma las/ nyes pa blo bur dang ldan zhing*// yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir// ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin// 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do// zhes pas/ breng ma chad par yon tan 'byung bas so// rnam thar za ma tog las/ de ni mi g.yo rtag tu mnyam gzhag thugs// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma 'dres gsal bar gzigs// sgrib bral mkhyen pa'i ye shes lam me ba// 'khor 'das kun gyi ngo bor gnas pa lags// zhes pa'i don no// drug pa 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag zhes pa theg chen rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar bai ḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la// lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar// de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la// thub pa'i dbang po sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char// zhes pas/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las sems can gyi khams la gnas shing thogs pa med par 'jug pa'o// dkon mchog rjes dran las/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' la gnas pa/ sems can thams cad la gzigs pa'i sa la bzhugs pa ste/ 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku che ba'i yon tan no// zhes pa'i don no// bdun pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni// zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa// de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can// rnam dbye sku yi bdag nyid dang*// zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang*// zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched dang*// theg chen nye bar longs spyod pa'i// thub pa longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed// ces pa'i don no// kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan nam/

dbang phyug brgyad ldan du shes par byas la/ da phyin chad rang gi sems nyid bla ma dam pa chos kyi sku'i 'du shes bskyed la/ mos gus drag pos gsol ba btab cing bsnyen pa bya'o// de ltar gzhi gdod ma nas rang gi sems chos sku'am bla ma dam par gnas pas/ bla ma'i gnas lugs ngo sprad pa yin gsungs/ gnyis pa gsang mtshan chos sku ngo sprod ni/ gzhi gdod ma nas rang sems bla mar gnas pa ni spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis dben pa de nyid bla ma dam pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas chos sku'i nges shes bskyed de/ sems gzung 'dzin spros pa'i yul las 'das par shes pa'i mos gus bya ba ni/ chos sku mnyam nyid kyi mos gus bya ba lags/ gsum pa chos sku 'khor 'das gnyis med ni/ rang gi rig pa rtsa bral rjen lhang nge ba de 'khor 'das thams cad la mnyam par gnas pa lags/ de la bla ma dam pa chos kyi sku'i nges shes bskyed la mos gus bya ba yin te/ yon tan gyi dbang du byas na/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes thugs su chud pas/ gang gis kyang gos pa med pas gtsang ba/ zhig cing gzhom du med pas rtag pa/ thams cad la khyab cing thams cad de'i ngo bor gnas pas bde ba/ yon tan thams cad mthar phyin par mnga' bas pha rol tu son pas te/ chos sku yon tan bzhi ldan no// mos gus kyi chos bzhi las/ mos gus kyi shes pa drod la brlan pa ni/ shes pa 'phro dus thugs kar mnyam par bzhag cing*/ 'phro mkhan gyi shes pa ngos gzung ba'o// mos gus kyi dbal bsgral ba ni/ shes pa gzengs bstod la nyams thod rgal du bskyang ngo*// mos gus kyi shes pa rtsal sbyang ba ni/ rig pa bag la nyal la mi bzhag par shes pa hur phyung la mos gus bya'o// mos gus kyi rig pa zhun 'dzin pa ni/ shes pa rang sar lhod glod la rtsol med kyi ngang nas mos gus bya'o// mos gus kyi yon tan gsum ni/

dag snang phyogs med du 'char ba/ snang srid bla mar 'char ba/ rkyen ngan grogs su 'char ba dang gsum mo// mos gus kyi lta sgom spyod gsum ni/ mos gus kyi rig pa mtha' dbus med par sgro 'dogs chod pa ni lta ba/ de nyams su myong zhing thams cad la mos gus skye ba/ rkyen gang gis kyang mi g.yo ba sgom pa/ snang srid thams cad grogs su 'char ba spyod pa yin gsungs/ don rtags ni sgom ro gcig rgyud la 'char ba/ mtshan rtags ni nam mkha' yongs su dag pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing la sogs pa rnams su phyin pa/ zhal mthong gsung thos pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams mang po mthong ba la sogs pa ltas khyad par can mang po 'byung ngo*// des gsang sgrub chos sku gnyis med du sgrub pa thon chos dang bcas pa'o// brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su longs/ ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba bya'o// ༈ //spyi don bzhi pa de kho na nyid ngo bo nyid du sgrub pa la'ang gsum ste/ chos nyid ma rig gsal byed/ mos gus lam mchog mthar thug chos sku snang srid lam khyer dang gsum gyi don/ snang gsum gcig tu 'dus pa bla ma dam pa'i mtshan nyid ji lta bu zhe na/ bla ma'i gnas lugs ngo 'phrod dgos te/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ don dam blo 'das sems nyid chos kyi sku// gdod nas ma skyes rang bzhin 'dus ma byas// blo bur rtog pa'i dri mas ma slad cing*// mi rtog zag med ting 'dzin zhi ba'i ngang*// bsgom bya sgom byed rtsol ba rnam spangs te// 'bad med chen por rang gis lhug par zhog /brjod bral blo 'das phyag rgya chen po'i don// sku gsum lhun grub bla ma dam pa lags// de ni bdud dang nyon mongs las rgyal zhing*// dpag med yon tan rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid do// grub mchog bla na med pa rgyal bas gsungs// zhes ngo bo nyid kyi sku de snang gsum gcig tu 'dus pa yin te/ sems nyid ngo bos stong pa chos kyi sku// gsal la ma 'gags pa de longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs rtog med shar ba sprul pa'i sku// de phyir chos rnams med ces ngo bo nyid// ces pa'i don nyams su myong nas gsal 'debs pa ni/

chos nyid ma rig gsal byed bya ba/ sems nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba bsgoms pas/ sems kyi gshis gang du yang ma grub pa zhig nyams su myong*/ de'i ngo bo la ltas pas/ rig stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su thag chod cing*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i nges shes shig skye ba yin/ yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid nyams su myong ba ni sku/ 'gag med mos gus kyi rtsal du shar ba ni gsung*/ snang sems gcig tu 'dres pa ni thugs/ de la blo rtsol ba dang bral ba ni skye ba med pa'i ngang nas mos gus byas pas/ nyams bag la nyal gyis nyes pa thams cad rang sar 'dag pa lags/ gnyis pa mos gus lam mchog mthar thug ni lhun grub 'du 'bral med pa'i bla ma la/ blo 'das smra bsam brjod med kyi mos gus/ de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa de gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum du yul yul can dbyer med/ rang dang 'du 'bral med par gnas pa lags te/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad du// drin can rje dang 'bral ma myong*// bdag 'bral med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba'i rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// nyams dga' ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar bla ma dang rang sems sangs rgyas gsum/ dbyer med pa'i don la dus dang rnam pa thams cad du gnas pa la gnas par ngo shes par byas shing*/ nges shes bskyed nas nyams su blang ngo*// gsum pa chos sku snang srid lam khyer ni// mtshan nyid de dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa de yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang ngo bo gcig pas/ des na bla ma la mchod pa dang gsol ba btab na/ rgyal ba thams cad la mchod pa dang gsol ba btab par 'gyur bas/ de ltar shes par byas nas/ mchod pa dang bstod pa ma byas na/ nyams bag la nyal phra'u dang shes sgrib mi 'dag pas/ de la mchod pa bya ba ni lam du 'khyer tshul mtshan bcas dang mtshan med gnyis su byed do// de la bdun rnam dag gi dbang du byas na/

phyag 'tshal ba mtshan bcas lus ngag yid gsum gyis dngos su 'tshal/ mtshan med mnyam gzhag ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// rang gis rang gi ngo bo ni// legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag bya// zhes pa'i don no// mchod pa 'bul ba mtshan bcas rdzas rim par bshams te 'bul/ mtshan med mchod bya dang mchod yul mi dmigs pa/ dwangs rang dwangs bla na med pa don gyi mchod pa'o// sdig pa bshags pa mtshan bcas thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar la bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad bshags shing*/ phyin chad sdom pa mtshan med mnyam gzhag ste/ drang po bzhag la drang por blta/ 'gyod tshangs rnams kyi mchog yin no// zhes so// gzhan yang bsags pa'i las dang*/ rang sems bla ma'i mtshan nyid gcig par bsgoms la mos gus phul na rnam smin gyi las thams cad skad gcig gis 'dag pa yin gsungs/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba mtshan bcas/ so skye nyan rang byang sems sangs rgyas rnams kyi bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang snyam pa'o// mtshan med mnyam par bzhag pas rjes su yi rang dmigs pa med pa'i rjes su yi rang chen po'o// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mtshan bcas dngos su lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa re thogs la/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ mtshan med mnyam gzhag ste/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs chos nyid zhi ba chen po'i ngang nas chos gsung bar bskul ba bla na med pa'o// mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa mtshan bcas/ dngos su snying khar thal mo sbyar te/ ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs par ma gyur gyi bar du bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa mtshan ma med pa mnyam gzhag ste/ sku gsung thugs gzhan du mi g.yo ba g.yung drung chos kyi sku rtag par bzhugs pa'i 'dod gsol bla na med pa'o// dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba mtshan bcas/

'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba bdag 'khor ma byed pa'o// mtshan med mnyam gzhag ste/ mdo rang nas dmigs pa med pa'i bsngo ba ni bsngo ba chen po'o// zhes bla na yod pa dang*/ bla na med pa ste/ tshogs gnyis zung 'jug byed pa lam 'khyer yin gsungs/ rang rig ye shes kyi mos gus kyi bogs 'don rtsal sbyong ba ni/ gnyen po kha nang du log nas sems nyid rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su shar ba/ mtshan nyid spros pa dang bral ba la stong pa nyid du blta zhing*/ rab kyis de'i ngang las mi g.yo bar nyams su blang*/ phyi tshogs drug mos gus kyi sgo mo la/ snang sems gnyis med du rtsal sbyang ba ni/ phyi tshogs drug gi snang ba sna tshogs pa thams cad sems nyid thugs phrad zung 'jug tu 'khyer zhing*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla mar shes par bya'o// snang sems gnyis med du ro bsre zhing tshogs drug gi snang ba ma 'gags tsam du rtsal sbyangs/ nam mkha' mnyam sbyor gyi shes rab stong pa nyid kyi rtsal sbyang ba ni/ phyi rol gyi nam mkha' sems bsres te/ phyi rol la mnyam par bzhag yang nang du sems nyid la phyi rol bsres la/ rang bzhin shes pa'i shes rab kyi phyi nang rtsal sbyong*/ de la nang gi rtsal sbyong de med na/ nang sems nyid la bdar sha mi chod/ mos gus kyi nyams bag la nyal du 'chor ba lags/ phyi snang ba la rtsal ma sbyangs na snang bas sems zil gyis mi non zhing*/ sems kyis snang ba zil gyis mi non pa dang*/ snang sems zung 'jug gi mos gus nyams su mi myong ba lags/ des na nyams su blangs shing rtsal sbyangs nas/ de las ldog pa'i yon tan rnams 'byung ba yin gsungs/ bar gyi rtsal sbyong 'dis shes rab kyi sgo 'byed pa dang*/ stong pa nyid la bogs thon pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis la bar chad med pa 'byung ngo*// mos gus kyi lam 'khyer gsum las/ nyon mongs pa lam du 'khyer ba/ rtog pa lam du 'khyer ba/

rkyen ngan lam du 'khyer ba'o// dang po nyon mongs pa de nyid ma dag pa logs su med de/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i chos sku de// nyon mongs rnam rtog dngos su gda'// rig dang ma rig gnyis med yin// ma rig ye shes chen po yin// zhes so// gnyis pa rtog pa lam du 'khyer ba ni/ kyai rdo rje las/ bza' bca' de bzhin btung ba nyid// ji ltar rnyed pa bzhin du bza'// yid 'ong mi 'ong rnam rtog yin// zhen pa tsam du mi bya'o// zhes so// rkyen ngan lam du 'khyer ba ni/ na tsha sdug bsngal thams cad rang sems dang bla ma las logs su gyur pa med/ smig sgyu'i chu yis su yang khyer ba med// gshin rje'i skyes bus su yang bsad pa med// ces pa dang*/ na ba lam gyi bogs 'don yin// 'chi ba sangs chung rgya ba yin// zhes gsungs pas/ bden zhen ma zhugs par bla ma'i mtshan nyid du shes pa'i mos gus kyi nyams su myong ba/ 'di kho na'i khyad chos yin gsungs/ mos gus kyi gzhan don gsum ni/ byin rlabs zhugs pa/ byin rlabs sbar ba/ byin rlabs kyi rgyud dag pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni slob ma dang rang rgyud bla ma'i mtshan nyid gsum/ gcig tu bsres la mnyam gzhag brtan pas byin rlabs 'jug cing rtogs pa skye nus pa yin/ gnyis pa ni nyams len snga ma ltar byas la/nyon mongs pa rnam rtog rkyen ngan gsum la rtsal sbyong byas pas kyang bar chad mi 'byung ba yin/ gsum pa ni rkyen ngan zhugs pa sogs la rang bzhin gyi sdug bsngal bsal ba'am/ gdon gyi sdug bsngal bsal ba gnyis las/ rang bzhin gyi sdug bsngal bsal ba gong gi dmigs pa bzhin no// gdon gyi sdug bsngal bsal ba ni pha rol po'i sems dang*/ gdon gyi sems dang na tsha sdug bsngal thams cad bsres la rang sems bla ma'i mtshan nyid shes par byas la/ skyon du mi lta zhing byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyun sring*/

mos gus dang lta thog tu bzhag pa/ gzhan rgyud kyi bar chad zhi zhing*/ rang la grib dang nyes skyon mi 'byung zhing gdon gyi gdug sems zhi nas byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan zhing*/ rnal 'byor pa'i gdong grogs byed pa yin gsungs/ las kyi 'brel pa bzhag pa 'dis/ thun mong ma yin pa'i 'brel pa zhes bya ste/ bdag gzhan gyi rgyud la brten nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ pha rol po'i sems/ bsags pa'i las/ rang sems bla ma'i mos gus gsum bsres la gsol ba btab na mthar las kyi rnam smin dag nas/ pha rol po'i rgyud byin gyis rlob cing*/ zhi zhing dul ba la sogs pa 'byung ba dang*/ rang gi rtogs pa bogs thon pa dang*/ mthar las gang byed kyi rigs dbang du 'du zhing*/ gdul byar 'gyur ba lags/ 'di gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gdams pa yin/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas don rtags su bsgom du med pa'i rtogs pa skye zhing*/ 'khor 'das gnyis med zung 'jug tu 'char ba/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi chos mngon du 'gyur/ mkhyen pa gnyis dang ldan zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa'o// mtshan rtags ni nyams sam rmi lam la nam mkha' yongs su dag pa la nyi zla shar ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang po mthong ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams mthong ba dang*/ skye 'gro'i sems rgyud shes pa sogs ltas khyad par can 'byung ngo*// des de kho na nyid ngo bo nyid du bsgrub pa thon chos dang bcas pa song ba lags/ brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su longs/ ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba bya'o// ༈ //bzhi pa rjes 'phrin las tha dad du sgrub pa la/ bla ma dam pa 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang mtshungs te/ nor bu la mchod pa byas na/ 'dod dgu'i re ba thams cad bsams bzhin du 'byung ngo*// de ltar bla ma dam pa la gsol ba btab na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba lags te/ mos gus srog 'khor gyi smad phrin las lam du 'khyer ba la/

shes rab bskyed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rnam par snang mdzad bla ma'i pho brang du/ rang sems bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal shes rab kyi ral gri thogs pa gcig tu bskyed la/ mchod 'bul dgu rnam dag dang*/ gsol 'debs gnyis po byas/ shes rab kyi ral gri klad la g.yugs pas/ mi shes rmongs pa'i srog rtsa rbad rbad bcad/ shes rab kyi snang ba lam lam rgyas par bsams nas/ srog 'khor gyi bsnyen pa byas na/ dus gsum shes pa'i shes rab dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i shes rab kyi spyan dang ldan par 'gyur ba lags// ༈ //tshe sring ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ snying gar seng ge sogs kyi gdan gyi steng du rang sems bla ma'i mtshan nyid mgon po tshe dpag med du bsgom/ mchod pa sogs dgu rnam dag dang*/ gsol 'debs gnyis po byas pas/ phyag gi 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi khol lus thams cad gang*/ 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsgom la/ srog 'khor gyi bsnyen pa la 'bad na tshe sring ba dang 'chi ba bslu ba lags// ༈ //nad zhi ba la bla ma sman gyi lhar bsgoms la gnad 'bebs byed/ yams nad la/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs de gang bar bsam/ des myur du bde ba lags// ༈ //longs spyod spel bar 'dod na/ rnam sras su bskyed na longs spyod char bzhin du 'beb pa lags// ༈ //phrin las bzhi la/ zhi ba la spyan ras gzigs su bsgom/ rgyas pa la rin chen 'byung ldan/ dbang la rdo rje phag mo/ drag po la chos skyong bsgom la gnad 'bebs byas pas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las gang byed 'grub pa lags// ༈ //khrus byed na bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ dbus su bla ma dam pa sprul sku'i ngo bor bskyed la/ mchod pa gsol 'debs bsnyen pa byas pas/ thugs kha'i sa bon las bdud rtsi bab pas/ sku lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga nas tshur byon chu 'o ma khol ba ltar dkar po bsam/ mthar bla ma dam pa bdud rtsir zhu nas/

gnyis su med par bsam la khrus byas pas bskal pa mang po'i sgrib pa 'dag nyes skyon las grol lo// ༈ //dbang bskur dus las bum la 'di bskyed do// rab gnas la me tog bsnyen pa dbang dus kyi sta gon dang 'dra/ bgegs bskrad la gtor ma gong ma bla ma yi dam/ bar pa chos skyong*/ 'og ma gzhi bdag la 'bul/ rten de rnams longs sprul gang yin yang*/ ngo bo chos skur bskyed la/ mchod 'bul mos gus kyi gsol 'debs bsnyen pa byas la/ skabs su bab tshe mos gus chen po'am/ byang chub kyi sems sam/ khyad par phyag rgya chen po rgyud la skyes pa zhig yin/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten la bltas tsam gyi rab gnas su 'gyur la/ tha na yang rnam rtog gi dben lhang ba zhig byung ba'i dus su me tog dor/ gsang mtshan dang ye dharmā brjod la/ bkra shis byed/ chos skyong la bka' srung bcol la bzhugs su gsol// ༈ //kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni rdzas mi dmigs par bsgom/ hūm̐ gis nyes skyon sbyangs/ āḥs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i ka pā lar bsam/ oṃ gyis zag med kyi bdud rtsir bsam/ yi ge gsum gyis dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bstim pa sogs byin rlabs byas/ mos gus kyis mchod 'bul gsol 'debs/ gsang mtshan gyi mthar yi ge gsum btags la 'bul zhing*/ tshogs gnyis rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod cing longs spyad na phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung ba lags/ khrus bya ba ni sbyang ba rnam dag bdud rtsir shes pa gong ltar bya'o// ༈ //dngos grub lag mchod bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rdzas swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ yi ge gsum gyi bskyed chog gong ltar byas la/ rten 'brel phyag rgyas kha bkab la yi ge gsum bzlas/ de nas chang la chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris la/ dbus su bla ma dam pa bde mchog yab yum sku bde ba chen pos rgyas pa zhig bsgom/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du srin lag g.yon pas bdud rtsi la reg byas/

bde chen gyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bskyed/ de rnams gtso 'khor la ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab dang dbang rtags bsgom/ rang gi srin lag g.yas g.yon bla ma'i thugs kar reg la/ bdud rtsir reg pas g.yas thig le dkar po/ g.yon dmar po/ dkrugs te gtor bas khams dkar dmar gyi rgyun chen po bab pas/ chang nang gi lha tshogs rnams la bde stong zag med kyi mchod pa phul bar bsam/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga'i tshul du gsang ba bum sku kha phye ba ltar/ bla ma dam pa'i pho brang du bskyed/ de'i nang du chos 'byung dang thig le lnga bkod/ dmigs pa dang bskyed chog gong ltar bya/ gzhan yang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma til gyi gang bu ltar bsam/ srin lag g.yas g.yon bdud rtsi la reg bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thig le dkar dmar 'phros/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong g.yas pa'i srin lag la reg pas thig le dkar po bab/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong g.yon pa'i srin lag la reg pas dmar po bab/ sor mo gnyis rtse sprad pas/ khams dkar dmar gyi rgyun chen po bab ste/ lag pa'i lha tshogs la mchod nas/ lha tshogs de thams cad bdud rtsi'i lha tshogs la thim/ de'i lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu nas chos 'byung dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhig tu gyur pa'i dbus su gsang mtshan yi ge rnams dkar ram me 'dug pa la dmigs te bzlas pas/ chos 'byung g.yon du 'khor te/ bdud rtsi dkar chil te khol ba la dmigs zhing lag mchod bya ba ni/ lag pa g.yon par bskyed chog gong ltar byas la/ g.yas pa'i srin lag gis bdud rtsi blangs nas lag pa'i lha tshogs la bdud rtsi gtor bas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dkar dmar bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'phros pas/ 'khor rnams la phog pas 'khor rnams kyang bde ba'i rang bzhin du phril phril song*/ yang 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar dmar 'phros/

bla ma dam pa yab yum gyi thugs kar thim pas/ bde stong gi mchod pas mnyes par bsam/ de ltar bdud rtsi gtor zhing dmigs pa dang zung 'jug tu gsang mtshan bzlas pa dang*/ mchod pa byed/ de nas thabs rdzas rnams g.yas bskor du lha la 'bul/ shes rab rdzas nang mchod g.yon bskor du gsang mtshan la yi ge gsum btags la 'bul/ bla ma bde mchog yab yum la yang rtsa sngags la yi ge gsum btags la 'bul/ de nas lag pa'i lha tshogs rnams gzhong par blugs la rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus ngag yid gsum du dbyer med du gyur/ lag pa phyag rgya spyi bor bcings/ oṃ gyis lus byin gyis brlabs/ mgrin par phyag rgya gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pas/ āḥs ngag byin gyis brlabs/ thugs kar rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya hūm̐ gis yid byin gyis brlabs/ ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yar ldog la/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes brjod/ des bar chad mi 'byung ba dang*/ bsrung bar 'gyur ba lags/ de nas tshogs la longs spyod/ rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod na/ mchog dang thun mong sku bzhi rtags brgyad thob par 'gyur/ 'di la tshig bka' rgya dang bcas pa rgya rnam pa bzhi yis 'ching ba yin te/ slob rgya/ lo rgya/ rin po che'i rgya/ yon tan rgya dang rnam pa bzhi/ slob rgya dus gcig la slob ma gsum phan chad la khrid mi gdab/ lo rgya/ slob ma'i tshogs ji snyed cig gnas kyang*/ lo gsum gyi bar ma bsten pa la mi bstan no// rin po che'i rgya/ dbang khrid ston pa'i dus su gser gyi yon dang maṇ+ḍal ma phul bar mi ston/ yon tan gyi rgya khrid gong ma'i yon tan ma skyes par dmigs pa 'og ma mi bstan/ rgya bzhi po 'di las ma 'das na tshe gcig lus gcig la 'bras bu mthong chos 'thob/ rgya bzhi 'das na bar chad 'byung zhing yon tan gong ma mi 'byung ngo*// dam tshig las ma 'das shing*/ tshig gi bka' rgya dang*/ tshogs maṇ+ḍal dang bcas te bstan no// des na su thod thod la ma bstan/

brgyud pa rin po che'i thugs dam snyan brgyud yin no// oṃ swa sti/ rgyal ba rnams kyi dgongs pa gcig pa'i brgyud// rig 'dzin rnams kyis brda don bstan pa'i brgyud// gang zag rnams kyi snyan du spros pa'i brgyud// brgyud gsum gcig tu dril ba 'jig rten mgon po'i gsung*// sku bzhi mngon gyur rdo rje'i zab lam 'di// gang gis nyams su blangs na tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'thob// 'di don sbyar ba'i dge ba rab dkar dri med des// mar gyur 'gro kun chos rje'i go 'phangs mchog thob shog// /ces so//

mos gus srog gi 'khor lo'i khrid 'di nyid rje rin po che 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zab chos dag las/ rang bzo dang snyan ngag med par gzhung don ji lta ba bzhin du/ las dang po pa rnams go bde ba dang*/ dharmā rā dzas mdzad pa'i khrid yig las/ gong 'og gzhung 'khrugs pa rnams sdebs te/ rgyal ba'i chos mdzod dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ 'dan bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ chu mo lug gi lo la/ spyan snga ā nan+da shrī bha dras 'bri gung 'og min gyi gdan sa chen por bkod pa'o// yi ge pa ni gtsang pa kun dga' dpal 'bar zhes bya'o// maṅga laṃ//
